notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.132

Customers → + New customer: adds a customer to QuickBooks straight away, with the name, company, e-mail and phone. It then opens the customer's page so you can fill in the mobile, bank details and customer type.
Enter sales receipt: + Add new customer is at the top of the customer list, as on Record payment. The new customer is chosen on the sale.
Both are for Accounts, the Finance Manager and Admin, and need sending to QuickBooks to be on.
Reconcile helper, the list of comparisons: filter by bank account (All, or one) and by From / To dates.
The dates show the comparisons whose statement period falls within them.
The page says how many are shown, and Show all clears the filter.
Archived comparisons still only appear with Show archived ticked.
